entry.title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Always a True Test

media:group.media:title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Always a True Test
media:group.media:description: The 2026 Rolex Middle Sea Race concluded with the final prizegiving in Valletta, Malta on Saturday 24 October. The ceremony offered a fitting end to a memorable 47th edition of the 606-nautical mile race. A total of 107 yachts crewed by 945 sailors from 55 countries contested this stringent offshore race which offered its typical examination of teamwork, tactics and endeavour. The wallyrocket 71 Django 7x was crowned overall winner on corrected time. For the second year running Black Jack 100 claimed the monohull line honours title. Organized by the Royal Malta Yacht Club, the race has been supported by Rolex as Title Sponsor since 2002. Discover more https://on.rolex.com/4ihd9lo #RolexMiddleSeaRace #Yachting

entry.title: Maxi Yacht Rolex Cup and Rolex Swan Cup – Intense Monohull Racing on the Mediterranean

media:group.media:title: Maxi Yacht Rolex Cup and Rolex Swan Cup – Intense Monohull Racing on the Mediterranean
media:group.media:description: The Yacht Club Costa Smeralda (YCCS) in Porto Cervo, Sardinia, stages two of the world’s most prestigious regattas – the annual Maxi Yacht Rolex Cup and the biennial Rolex Swan Cup, with the latter featuring a record-breaking fleet of 170 Swan yachts on the 60th anniversary of the renowned Finnish boatyard Nautor Swan. At this year’s Maxi showpiece, six classes were decided, including two world titles. Leopard 3, owned by Joost Schuijff, secured the Rolex IMA Maxi 1 World Championship for the second time, while Peter Dubens’ Northstar III, featuring the latest in keel, deck and mast design, won the Rolex IMA Maxi Grand Prix Championship. At the Swan Cup, the four best performing yachts topping their respective divisions were Gérard Logel’s Swan 601 robas (Maxi), Fernando Chain’s Swan 45 From Now On (Cruiser/Racer), William Graves’ Swan 44 Pride (Legacy) and Hendrik Brandis’ ClubSwan 50 Earlybird (One Design). Rolex has partnered the YCCS and been Title Sponsor of its flagship events for more than 40 years. Discover more https://on.rolex.com/4zGsao9 #Rolex #MaxiYachtRolexCup #RolexSwanCup

entry.title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Black Jack 100 Repeats Line Honours Success

media:group.media:title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Black Jack 100 Repeats Line Honours Success
media:group.media:description: Line honours has been decided at the 2026 Rolex Middle Sea Race. For the second straight year, Black Jack 100 was the first yacht to cross the finish line in Marsamxett Harbour, Malta. She completed the 606-nautical-mile race course in an elapsed time of 2 days, 3 hours and 51 minutes, bettering her 2025 time by over 13 and a half hours. Black Jack 100 assumed leadership of the race in its early stages and maintained an impressive advantage over her rivals throughout. An international fleet of 107 yachts is contesting the 47th edition of the Rolex Middle Sea Race, an epic contest founded in 1968, organized by the Royal Malta Yacht Club, and supported by Rolex as Title Sponsor since 2002. Discover more https://on.rolex.com/482CqLk #RolexMiddleSeaRace #Yachting

entry.title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Underway From Grand Harbour

media:group.media:title: Rolex Middle Sea Race 2026 – Underway From Grand Harbour
media:group.media:description: The 2026 Rolex Middle Sea Race commenced on Saturday 17 October with an international fleet of 107 yachts embarking on one of offshore sailing’s most revered contests. Founded in 1968, this 606-nautical-mile race is organized by the Royal Malta Yacht Club and Rolex has been Title Sponsor since 2002. Following the start from Valletta’s historic Grand Harbour, competitors take on a scenic and challenging racecourse comprising an anticlockwise circumnavigation of Sicily and passing two active volcanoes. Frequent changes in geography and direction bring constant shifts in wind conditions and sea state. The race is gruelling, with most of the fleet braced for three to six days at sea before finishing back in Malta. Discover more https://on.rolex.com/4sdfano #RolexMiddleSeaRace #Yachting

media:group.media:description: The Rolex Middle Sea Race offers a rare combination: an extraordinary setting and a challenge that demands everything from those who take it on.
